title: Nexus StrategyPatchTransitionRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/daemon/strategies/{strategy_id}/transitions/patch (V1.109). Rewires or creates an outer transition (linear next, conditional branch, or default target) and/or updates its condition label.

strategy_id.description: Preset / Strategy identifier from the URL path. Must match the path parameter.

base_revision.description: Revision observed by the client on the last canonical read.

source_state_id.description: State whose outgoing transition is being modified.

old_target.description: Current target state identifier of the transition to replace. Required when op is 'update' (default).

new_target.description: New target state identifier. Required when op is 'create', optional when op is 'update'.

condition.description: For conditional / labeled branches, identifies the branch to update or create.

transition_kind.description: Optional disambiguator for the transition form being edited.

op.description: Operation to perform: 'create' adds a new outgoing transition, 'update' (default) rewires an existing transition.
